description: F-101B-110-MC c/n 701 (block 58-0325/0330); Oregon ANG 123rd FIS 1977-79; New York ANG 136th FIS by 1982; converted to a GF-101B ground trainer at Sheppard AFB; NMUSAF loan to the City of Rogers (2016 loan list); dedicated 12 Jul 1991 with a McDonnell marker (HMdb 62520); on a curved pedestal at the airport entrance; the Wikipedia F-101 survivor list (2026) and an Arkansas Living article of Nov 2023 confirm the jet in place
aliases: GF-101B; c/n 701; One-Oh-Wonder; F101; F101B; GF101B
museum_name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial -- Rogers Executive Airport

description: UH-1H-BF c/n 9614 (block 67-17145/17859); taken on strength Apr 1968 per the Aerial Visuals Goldbook-derived history; served the 71st Assault Helicopter Company (Rattlers/Firebirds) at Chu Lai May 1968-Feb 1969 and was damaged several times in Vietnam; to the Army National Guard Jun 1973; placed on a pole beside the F-101 in a banked attitude in Apr 2000; painted with Headhunters titles; the Arkansas Living article of Nov 2023 confirms the helicopter still displayed
museum_name: Vietnam Veterans Memorial -- Rogers Executive Airport
